challenge.method: Compare an ordinary namespace qualifier, the js special namespace, a Clojure Java static field, and host availability of a given global.
challenge.results: The document gives the qualifier and access mechanism. The availability of a specific property belongs to the JavaScript host configuration.

limitations: The accepted meaning describes the documented ClojureScript source form. It does not imply the presence of particular properties on every host.
